description: This PHP class 'Address' within the 'Opencart' e-commerce platform manages customer address operations, including viewing, creating, editing, deleting, and fetching address data in an admin context.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: A controller class handling customer address CRUD operations and address data retrieval in the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the language file and outputs the address list view for a specific customer.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves and displays all addresses associated with a customer, generating links for editing and deleting addresses.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares the address form for adding or editing an address, including populating fields with existing data and custom fields.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or edited address, including validation and permission checks, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified address after permission check and returns JSON success or error message.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Fetches address details for display, typically in AJAX requests, returning JSON data.
